systems.country_label: registers of civil status / état civil
systems.owner: commune mayors, their administrators and deputies, under Law on Civil Status No. 84-10
systems.tiers: a civil registry office at the headquarters of each commune; decentralised; compiled December 2016 to November 2017

note: States that commune civil registry offices processed births, marriages and deaths manually on paper in 2016-17; that is the records application, and nothing is said of the offices' connection.
